name: aside
title: Aside
description: Search and control open tabs, bookmarks, and browser history in Aside
author: asifk

preferences.name: profile
preferences.title: Aside Profile
preferences.description: Default profile for bookmarks and history. Switch profiles from command dropdowns.

commands.name: search-web
commands.title: Search Aside
commands.subtitle: Aside
commands.description: Search open tabs, bookmarks, browser history, and the web from one bar.

commands.name: search-bookmarks
commands.title: Search Bookmarks
commands.subtitle: Aside
commands.description: Search Aside bookmarks and open them in Aside.

commands.name: search-history
commands.title: Search Browser History
commands.subtitle: Aside
commands.description: Search Aside browsing history and reopen visited pages.

commands.name: open-new-tab
commands.title: Open New Tab
commands.subtitle: Aside
commands.description: Open a new tab in Aside.

commands.name: open-new-incognito-window
commands.title: Open New Incognito Window
commands.subtitle: Aside
commands.description: Open a new Aside incognito window.

tools.name: get-tabs
tools.title: Get Open Tabs
tools.description: Find live Aside tabs and return their current session-scoped IDs and browser metadata.

tools.name: get-active-tab
tools.title: Get Active Tab
tools.description: Get the active tab from Aside's frontmost window.

tools.name: search-history
tools.title: Search History
tools.description: Search the configured Aside profile's local browsing history.

tools.name: search-bookmarks
tools.title: Search Bookmarks
tools.description: Search bookmarks in the configured Aside profile.

tools.name: new-tab
tools.title: Open New Tab
tools.description: Open a blank Aside tab or open a URL in a new Aside tab.

tools.name: new-window
tools.title: Open New Window
tools.description: Open a new normal Aside window.

tools.name: new-incognito-window
tools.title: Open New Incognito Window
tools.description: Open a new incognito Aside window.

tools.name: focus-tab
tools.title: Focus Tab
tools.description: Focus an existing Aside tab using the exact live ID returned by get-tabs or get-active-tab.

tools.name: reload-tab
tools.title: Reload Tab
tools.description: Reload an Aside tab using the exact live ID returned by get-tabs or get-active-tab.

tools.name: close-tab
tools.title: Close Tab
tools.description: Close an Aside tab using the exact live ID returned by get-tabs or get-active-tab.

tools.name: deduplicate-tabs
tools.title: Deduplicate Tabs
tools.description: Close duplicate Aside tabs while preserving the first open tab for each exact URL.
